description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Berta, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
